issues.t: Passenger seat airbag sensor mat can fail (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light or the passenger airbag status light comes on and stays on, or the passenger airbag indicator flips between on and off as someone shifts in the seat.
issues.why: A sensor mat inside the front passenger seat cushion tells the car who is sitting there. Repeated flexing wears it out, so the system can misjudge the occupant. Suzuki recalled 2007-2011 SX4s because the airbag could then deploy for a small child.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have a Suzuki-authorized shop replace the seat cushion assembly. Until it is fixed, keep children in the back seat.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake pressed (recall)
issues.sym: The gear lever moves out of Park even though your foot is not on the brake pedal, so the car can roll.
issues.why: A defect in the automatic shift selector assembly lets the shift lock be bypassed. It affects SX4s built from July 2009 to November 2012.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake when you park. Check your VIN for the open recall; the fix is a new shift selector assembly.

issues.t: Drive belt tensioner spring can break (recall)
issues.sym: Squealing from the engine, the battery light coming on, heavy steering, or the engine running hot. In some cases the drive belt comes off and the engine stalls.
issues.why: The spring inside the belt tension adjuster pulley was made incorrectly and can snap. The belt then slips or falls off and stops driving the alternator and other parts. It affects 2010 SX4s and 2011s built before mid-October 2010.
issues.next: If the battery light comes on or you hear belt squeal, stop driving and check the belt. Ask a dealer to confirm the tensioner recall was done.

issues.t: Outside mirror can work loose and fall off (recall)
issues.sym: An outside mirror feels loose, wobbles at speed, or comes off its base.
issues.why: Vibration can back out the three screws that hold each outside mirror to its mount.
issues.next: Have a dealer check both mirrors and confirm the recall screws were replaced. Don't drive with a missing mirror.

issues.t: CVT automatic stops shifting or fails
issues.sym: Whining or loud noise from the transmission, weak acceleration, the engine revving with little speed gain, a check engine light, or the car going into a limited mode and refusing to drive.
issues.why: The continuously variable automatic used from 2010 can overheat or suffer internal valve body and solenoid faults. Once it fails, shops usually recommend a replacement transmission.
issues.next: Check that the CVT fluid has been changed on schedule. If warning lights or shifting problems appear, have the transmission scanned before driving far, since a failing CVT can leave you stranded.

issues.t: Manual transmission slips out of 5th gear
issues.sym: With the manual gearbox, the lever pops out of 5th or the car acts like it is in neutral in 5th while the engine revs freely.
issues.why: A worn 5th gear synchronizer is the usual cause. In some cases the gear or its parts fail inside the gearbox.
issues.next: Have the gearbox inspected. A worn synchronizer can sometimes be repaired, but a failed gear usually means rebuilding or replacing the transmission.

issues.t: Worn tie rod ends
issues.sym: Clunking over bumps, loose or wandering steering, or uneven wear on the front tires.
issues.why: Tie rod ends are the most often replaced part on the SX4 in owner repair surveys. Their ball joints wear and develop play.
issues.next: Have the front end checked for play. Replace worn tie rod ends and get a wheel alignment afterward.

issues.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
issues.sym: A humming, droning or grinding noise that grows with speed and may change when you turn. The ABS light can come on if the bearing damages the speed sensor.
issues.why: Wheel bearings and hubs are among the most commonly replaced parts on this car. Worn bearings get loud and loose.
issues.next: Have the wheel bearings checked. A badly worn bearing can overheat or let the wheel wobble, so don't put it off.

issues.t: Front control arm bushings and ball joints wear out
issues.sym: Clunks or rattles over bumps, shaking, or the car feeling loose in the front end.
issues.why: Control arm bushings and ball joints wear on this car more than many owners expect. Some owners report the noise returning after only the bushings were replaced.
issues.next: Have the whole front suspension inspected so worn ball joints and links are fixed at the same time. Get an alignment after the repair.

issues.t: Sticking brake caliper
issues.sym: The car pulls to one side, one wheel is much hotter than the others, there is a burning smell after driving, or brake pads wear unevenly.
issues.why: Brake calipers are one of the more frequently replaced parts on the SX4. A caliper piston or slide pin can stick and keep the pad pressed against the rotor.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected soon. A sticking caliper wears out pads and rotors fast and can overheat the brakes.

issues.t: Catalytic converter failure
issues.sym: Check engine light (often a catalyst efficiency code), a failed emissions test, a rotten-egg smell, or sluggish acceleration if the converter is clogged.
issues.why: Owners report replacing catalytic converters on the SX4 more often than expected for a small car. Misfires or oil burning can speed up the damage.
issues.next: Have the codes read and make sure there are no misfires or bad oxygen sensors first. Ask whether the federal emissions warranty still covers the converter.

issues.t: Alternator failure
issues.sym: Battery light on, dim or flickering lights, a dead battery, or the car stalling.
issues.why: Alternator replacements are common on the SX4. On 2010-2011 cars, a broken belt tensioner can also stop the alternator from charging.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. Check the belt and tensioner at the same time.

issues.t: AWD rear driveshaft or joint wears out
issues.sym: Vibration or a clunk from under the car, especially when pulling away, or a drone at highway speed on AWD models.
issues.why: The longitudinal driveshaft that feeds the rear wheels on AWD SX4s, and its joints, show up often in owner repair records.
issues.next: Have the driveshaft and its joints checked for play. Replacing a worn joint early can avoid replacing the full shaft.

issues.t: Exhaust flex pipe or hanger failure
issues.sym: A louder exhaust, a rattle or buzz from underneath, or a ticking leak sound on acceleration.
issues.why: The flexible section of the exhaust and its hangers and clamps are a common replacement on this car.
issues.next: Have the exhaust inspected. Fix leaks near the front of the car promptly, since fumes can reach the cabin.

issues.t: Oxygen sensor failure
issues.sym: Check engine light, worse fuel economy, or rough running.
issues.why: Oxygen sensors are a frequent repair on the SX4. They wear out with age, and oil or coolant leaks can contaminate them.
issues.next: Have the codes read to find which sensor failed. Exhaust leaks can set the same codes, so rule those out first.

issues.t: Axle or output shaft seal leak
issues.sym: Oily drips near a front wheel or under the rear differential, or a burning oil smell.
issues.why: Axle and output shaft seals harden and leak with age on this car, letting gear oil or transmission fluid escape.
issues.next: Have the leak traced and check the fluid level. Low fluid can damage the transmission or rear differential.

issues.t: Water pump leak
issues.sym: Coolant puddles at the front of the engine, a sweet smell, the temperature gauge rising, or a whine from the belt area.
issues.why: The water pump seal or bearing wears out. Water pump replacement shows up regularly in SX4 repair records.
issues.next: Watch the coolant level and temperature gauge. If the engine starts to overheat, pull over and shut it off.

issues.t: Worn struts or shocks
issues.sym: A bouncy or floaty ride, the nose diving when braking, knocking over bumps, or oil on the strut bodies.
issues.why: Struts and shock absorbers wear out and are regularly replaced on higher-mileage SX4s.
issues.next: Have the struts checked for leaks and bounce. Replace them in pairs and check the alignment afterward.

issues.t: Ticking or rattle on cold start
issues.sym: A loud clicking or rattling from the engine for a few seconds after a cold start.
issues.why: Owners and shops have traced this to the timing chain and its tensioners on the early 2.0L engine. Low or old oil makes it worse.
issues.next: Keep the oil full and changed on time. If the noise lasts longer or a check engine light appears, have the timing chain checked before it causes damage.

issues.t: Tire pressure sensor valve stems crack and leak
issues.sym: The tire pressure light comes on and a tire slowly loses air.
issues.why: Owners report the metal stems of the tire pressure sensors corroding and cracking along their length.
issues.next: Have the tire shop check the valve stems and replace any cracked sensor stems or sensors.
